method: single-band scale-normalized Laplacian-of-Gaussian blob candidates; square bounding boxes; one-to-one greedy IoU>=0.5
test_set: official standard-label test split, truncated and <5px reference labels removed; 46 tiles
limits: Threshold chosen by validation F1; this is a simple classical baseline, not a crater-specific trained model. No test retuning. Scale and threshold choices affect the result.
